title: On the Cardinality of the Smith Set Under Impartial Culture with Many Alternatives
summary: For some integer $\ell\geq 2$, consider $m=2\ell-1$ voters, each of which has a preference ranking over $n$ alternatives. The Smith set is the smallest nonempty set of alternatives each of which defeats every alternative outside the set in a pairwise majority comparison. Under the standard benchmark impartial culture where each voter uniformly and independently chooses a random preference ranking over all alternatives, we study the asymptotic probability that the Smith set has cardinality $s$ for fixed $\ell$ and $n\to \infty$.
